The screen is ready. You can open it at **http://maker:4001**

**Let's walk through flow 1 — saving a link.**

Please do this one action: in the box at the top, paste this link and press **Save**:

```
https://nasa.gov/webb
```

Watch what happens — you'll briefly see it working, then the saved item appears in your collection **with the page's title, site, and a short description filled in automatically**, without you typing any of that. Feel free to save a second one too (for example one of your own links) to see it stack up.

A couple of things I decided for you here that I'd like you to weigh in on:

- For each saved item, I chose to show a **title, the site it's from, a short description, the link itself, and when you saved it** (plus a little thumbnail spot). That's my guess at "the useful page details" — please tell me if that's the right set, or if something's missing or unnecessary.
- Saving is a **single step**: paste, press Save, done — the details fill in on their own. Check whether that feels as effortless as you want.

**Once you've tried it, tell me: does this saving experience match what you had in mind?**
